subtitle: Lesson 14 · System Design for Data Engineers

code:
MERGE INTO silver_orders AS target
USING cleaned_bronze_batch AS source
ON target.order_id = source.order_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
caption: A rerun on the same batch must never duplicate rows.

code:
Silver:            MERGE, incremental -- almost always
Gold (small):       overwrite -- simpler, just as correct
Gold (large):       incremental MERGE -- same reason as silver
caption: Chosen by rebuild cost, not by habit.

code:
last_processed = MAX(_ingested_at) FROM silver.trips
new_rows = bronze.trips WHERE _ingested_at > last_processed
-- or: Delta's own Change Data Feed, reading the log directly
caption: Incrementality needs an explicit mechanism, not a hope.
